formula: For XSD and SOXX on each source date t, one-session gross total return=(Yahoo split-restated close_t + Yahoo ex-date dividend_t in the same present-share basis)/Yahoo split-restated close_(t-1); take difference of sums of 20 latest log gross returns ending at signal date s: XSD minus SOXX. Require positive finite returns, exact 20 source sessions, no value after s. A split date must not create a mechanical jump.
timing: Stage1 signal date s close/ex-date cash is before next-session preopen decision. Current retrospective corporate action revisions are not first-public vintage qualified. This phase cannot authorize account or promotion.

quality.redundancy: Report full original Stage1 39 training pairwise Pearson correlations and max absolute value; abs>=0.95 marks likely duplicate and stops before any model. This is a necessary but not sufficient novelty check.

artifacts: Native Qlib D.calendar and D.features source-plane diagnostic, DatasetH mapped full signal calendar, source and redundancy artifacts in Qlib Recorder; archive and readback NAS.
stop: Any pinned hash, NAS source receipt, source identity, date/return/split/adjclose tolerance, full Stage1 feature coverage, Qlib, Recorder or NAS failure stops without changing formula. A pairwise duplicate closes before information fit. Passing remains source-only and retrospective, with vintage and independent history unresolved.
